title: Image Classification: A Reproducible NumPy Pipeline

questions.question: What does synthetic_cifar(4, 3, 8, seed=0) create?
options: Four downloaded CIFAR batches with 10,000 classes
A single CHW image and a scalar loss
12 local NHWC images of shape (8,8,3) and integer labels for three classes
12 grayscale images with shape (3,8,8) and floating labels
questions.explanation: The helper creates num_per_class*num_classes local color/texture fixtures in NHWC [0,1] format; its name does not imply a dataset download.

questions.question: Why does softmax subtract the largest logit before exponentiating?
options: It forces the highest class probability to zero
It changes hard labels into one-hot arrays
It makes every class probability equal
It preserves the probability ratios while avoiding overflow for large finite logits
questions.explanation: Subtracting a shared maximum leaves softmax unchanged mathematically but keeps exponentials in a numerically manageable range.

questions.question: What must each row of a soft target passed to cross_entropy sum to?
options: One
The batch size
The largest logit
Zero
questions.explanation: The API treats a two-dimensional target as a probability distribution over classes and rejects negative rows or rows that do not sum to one.

questions.question: What does mixup_batch return for two images and num_classes=2?
options: Only the image permutation, leaving labels as integer scalars
Mixed images and two-element soft label rows whose entries sum to one
A crop of each image with a new spatial shape
Logits already normalized by softmax
questions.explanation: Mixup interpolates a batch permutation and the corresponding one-hot labels with the same Beta-sampled coefficient.

questions.question: What is the most useful evidence in confusion_matrix plus per_class_report?
options: That a model is calibrated for every possible deployment domain
That augmentation never changed a training image
Which target/prediction pairs occur and how precision, recall, and F1 differ by class
That the local fixture is the official CIFAR test set
questions.explanation: The matrix exposes class-specific error directions; the report derives per-class metrics and makes imbalance visible without claiming calibration or benchmark provenance.

questions.question: Why should the same mean/std definition be used for validation after training transforms?
options: It guarantees higher validation accuracy than training accuracy
It converts validation labels into soft mixup targets
It makes the validation split part of the training set
It keeps the feature scale comparable while leaving validation free of random augmentation
questions.explanation: Standardization is part of the model-input contract; validation should apply its deterministic version without importing training-only random operations or leakage.
